summary: Iteration 6 — end-to-end verification of the THREE new feature areas (Documents Library, Blogs/News, Calendar ICS+Word import). New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_documents_blogs_calendar.py (31 tests, all pass). Full backend suite now 110/110 passing (previous stale failures fixed by upstream changes). Playwright drives every documented user flow: (a) admin uploads a doc, sends to parents, deletes it — toast 'Sent to 1 recipient(s).1 to dashboards, 1 email(s).' seen; (b) admin creates published post + draft, /news lists only the published post, /news/:slug renders body, share-facebook opens a real https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=... popup, back-to-news works; cadet sees the same post in member-news-list; (c) ICS Subscribe copies the /api/calendar/events.ics link and toasts, Word .docx (built on the fly with python-docx) parses into 3 preview rows and import creates 3 events that appear in the calendar; ICS public feed returns valid text/calendar with those events; (d) parent Inbox shows the sent-document notifications with correct Download-button hrefs pointing at /api/documents/<id>/download. Draft posts are correctly hidden from /public/blogs. No blocking issues.

minor.issue: Uses BlogCreate schema (title min_length=2 + body min_length=1 required). Cannot do a partial update like {'status':'published'} — returns 422. Frontend BlogAdminPanel always sends the full payload so this is fine in practice, but the endpoint is misleadingly named PATCH; consider making all BlogCreate fields Optional or introducing a BlogUpdate model with partial semantics.

Buffers the whole GridFS blob into memory (data = await stream.read()) before returning. Same pattern used for /api/blogs/image/{id}. StreamingResponse over fs.open_download_stream would scale better under concurrent downloads.

Each does await file.read() before the size check, so an oversized upload is still fully buffered in memory before the 413 is returned. Prefer a Content-Length pre-check or a chunked-read + early abort.

payload.base_url is trusted verbatim from the client and embedded into outgoing email HTML plus dashboard notifications (`link` field). Low risk today (staff-only) but a safer default is deriving base_url from request.base_url or a SITE_BASE_URL env var. Same issue was flagged in iteration_5 for /enquiries/{id}/recruit-email.

issues: Subscribe ICS still writes a JS confirm-less clipboard toast that is fine, but 'Subscribe' does not offer a fallback 'Copy manually' path if the browser blocks clipboard-write (Safari private mode). Consider showing the URL in a small popover for manual copy.

Post list shows only title + status badge but no published_at date column; author name is 'Staff' rather than the admin's actual name (backend author_name is set correctly for new posts — appears to be only a display issue on the list card).

action_items: OPTIONAL: derive base_url server-side (request.base_url or SITE_BASE_URL env) for documents/send and enquiries/recruit-email — safer than trusting the client to supply it.
OPTIONAL: introduce BlogUpdate model with Optional fields so PATCH /api/blogs/{id} supports partial updates (e.g. flipping status without re-sending title/body).
OPTIONAL: swap document/image download endpoints to StreamingResponse(fs.open_download_stream(...)) to avoid buffering GridFS blobs in memory.

PRE-EXISTING (still open from iterations 3/4/5): server.py is now 1583 lines — split into routers (auth/users/events/notices/messages/enquiries/recruit/attachments/broadcast/newsletters/documents/blogs/calendar) is overdue.
PRE-EXISTING (still open from iteration 5): RecruitmentPanel.handleBulk() still uses window.confirm() for the countdown buckets — inconsistent with the shadcn dialog used everywhere else.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: 1583 lines — repeatedly flagged. The Documents (~90 lines), Blogs (~110 lines), Calendar/ICS+Word (~140 lines) additions in this iteration are cleanly separable modules; splitting into routers is now mandatory-for-maintainability.

PATCH /api/blogs/{id} reuses BlogCreate — validation forces callers to send the full payload for a status flip. Fine today because the frontend does that, but the API contract is misleading. Introduce BlogUpdate with Optional[str] fields.

_parse_docx_events discards rows where a date can't be parsed (correct — the docx importer test verified heading-only rows are ignored) but it silently drops rows: consider returning parsed vs skipped counts so the staff-facing preview can warn 'N rows could not be parsed'.

deliver_broadcast now carries link/link_label — good. But the dashboard notification is inserted with the full absolute URL (payload.base_url + /api/documents/<id>/download). If the site domain changes, historical notifications will keep pointing at the old host. Consider storing only the path and letting the UI prefix it with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at render time.
public/blogs endpoint returns list without pagination — with a large news archive this will grow unbounded (currently capped at 200 in code, but no page/query parameters). Add ?limit and ?skip.

GridFS blobs for blog images and documents are never garbage-collected if a document is edited (cover_image_url swapped out) — the previous gridfs blob is orphaned. Add a cleanup pass or delete-on-replace.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of all tested flows (documents staff+member+parent, blogs admin+public+cadet, calendar ICS+word-import+public feed, parent inbox notifications)

rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two initial test failures during writing were self-inflicted: (1) sending only {'status':'published'} to PATCH /blogs raised 422 because BlogCreate requires title+body — fixed by sending the full payload (mirrors what the frontend does); (2) /enquiries/tracker returns {'buckets':..., 'counts':..., 'labels':...} not the buckets at the top level — my test was fixed to unwrap 'buckets' first. The 422 on PATCH /blogs is arguably a minor API smell but not a bug given the frontend contract.
